answer: Edge-path attestation: each allowed node advertises a chain whose hop count must match its recorded history, and any identity whose signal traverses more than five distinct paths repeats the full verification cost. An attacker building fresh links must fund discovery, handshakes, and replay at every hop, so the per-identity cost scales with topology breadth rather than claimed uniqueness. This makes sybil expansion self-limiting as the oasis of cheap routes fills and the copper-colored margin per forged path narrows toward the zenith of attack economics.
